tool-inputs.title: Tool input awaiting a response
tool-inputs.loading: Reading input for the current node…
tool-inputs.empty: No pending tool input or readable input history is currently available.
tool-inputs.experimental: Experimental input capability: requires explicit local configuration. Configured capability does not establish online status.
tool-inputs.historical_readonly: This request is read-only. It cannot be answered again or have its original answer changed.
tool-inputs.capability_disabled: Input capability is not configured for the current node. Authorized history remains read-only.
tool-inputs.access_denied: Current access changed. Input and responses are no longer displayed. Check project access.
tool-inputs.invalid_read: The current tool input could not be verified. Read it again.
tool-inputs.intent_unavailable: The original answer request could not be verified. Preserve it and check the current scope.
tool-inputs.refresh_failed: Current tool input could not be read. Read it again before responding.
tool-inputs.original_pending: The original answer is unconfirmed. Reconcile that same request before submitting another answer.
tool-inputs.background_paused: Background reading is paused. Explicitly read current tool input again.
tool-inputs.boundary: Saving an answer on the platform does not establish native delivery, model continuation or successful execution.
tool-inputs.no_credentials: Do not enter passwords, tokens or other credentials. Use the original secure configuration flow.
tool-inputs.secret_unsupported: This request contains an unsupported sensitive question and cannot be displayed or answered through ordinary input.
tool-inputs.no_saved_answer: No human answer was saved for this question.
tool-inputs.blocking: The native request is marked as blocking input. This does not replace the formal task run state.
tool-inputs.not_blocking: The native request is not marked as blocking. This does not establish that the task is paused.
tool-inputs.delivery.saved: The platform saved the human response.
tool-inputs.delivery.observed: The Runner observed the original answer.
tool-inputs.delivery.written: The native reply was fully written. This does not establish successful model continuation.
tool-inputs.delivery.unknown: Original answer delivery or writing needs reconciliation. This request is read-only; preserve it and do not blindly answer again.
tool-inputs.closed_without_answer: The original request closed without a saved human answer. Native cleanup is not an answer.
tool-inputs.source_details: View original scope and delivery evidence
tool-inputs.cursor_boundary: This input belongs to the original Cursor execution. Saving a response does not establish native delivery, continued execution or command permission.
tool-inputs.multiple_choice: Choose one or more original options.
tool-inputs.no_saved_selection: No option response was saved for this question.
tool-inputs.plan_boundary: Accepting this native plan does not adopt platform tasks, change formal requirements, grant command or file permission, or establish human acceptance. The tool may save a plan file in this execution's private directory.
tool-inputs.plan_items_boundary: These statuses belong to the tool's proposed plan. They are not platform task progress or human acceptance facts.
